title: European Region Peril Codes (v2.10)
text:
European Region Peril Codes (v2.10)

UNICEDE
/2 supports the following codes for
 Perils Covered for the risks in Europe supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

| Use... | If risks are covered for... |
| --- | --- |
| PWS | Windstorm only |
| PEQ | Earthquake only |
| PFL | Flood Only |
| PAN | Pandemic |

Note:

The countries in the European region where each of these perils is
 currently modeled by 
Verisk
:

Windstorm/Severe Thunderstorm

Austria, Belgium, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France,
 Germany, Hungary, Republic of Ireland, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg,
 Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Slovakia, Slovenia, Sweden, Switzerland, United
 Kingdom

Earthquake

Albania, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark,
 Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Republic of Ireland, Israel,
 Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Macedonia, Netherlands, Norway, Poland,
 Portugal, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, United
 Kingdom

Flood

Albania, Austria, Czech Republic, Germany, Italy, Macedonia, Poland,
 Serbia, Switzerland, United Kingdom

Pandemic

France, Germany, United Kingdom

Use 
W
 as the coverage for the pandemic peril
